metadata.description: Skills for integrated-photonics (TFLN) and OCT research: figures, manuscript writing, literature and scientific computing. A hand-written photonics plugin plus a curated subset auto-synced daily from K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills and Yuan1z0825/nature-skills.

plugins.name: photonics-oct
plugins.description: Personal defaults for integrated-photonics / OCT work: matplotlib figure style and plot recipes for Optica, Nature and Science journals, and a LaTeX manuscript guide with photonics terminology. Start here for any figure or paper task.

plugins.name: sci-computing
plugins.description: Python scientific computing for photonics research: Matplotlib and publication figures, SymPy, units and uncertainty, quantum simulation (QuTiP, Qiskit, PennyLane), statistics, ML (scikit-learn, Lightning), multi-objective optimization, GPU acceleration, lab-hardware CAD.

plugins.name: sci-research-writing
plugins.description: Literature search and review, BibTeX citation management, Zotero, grant proposals, LaTeX venue templates and posters, research talks and ideation.

plugins.name: nature-skills
plugins.description: Manuscript workflow: drafting, polishing and zh-to-en translation, figure QA, reference verification, mock review, response to reviewers, data-availability statements and deep paper reading.
